row.reason: APi Group sells safety and specialty services (fire protection, life safety, HVAC and similar building systems work) to building owners and operators. Amentum sells advanced engineering, technical and mission-support services under long-term contracts, mainly to government customers in defense, space, nuclear and intelligence. The offerings and the main customers differ. Both are labor-based service contractors, but that shared model is too thin to make them peers.
